newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-WORLD BANK MEETS PM, BACKS SELLOFFS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-WORLD BANK MEETS PM, BACKS SELLOFFS.

text.p: A World Bank mission applauded on Wednesday the government's aim to sell big state companies in the energy, transport and communication sectors and suggested additions to the programme, the government press office said.

"The World Bank not only supports the privatisation of the country's big companies but even suggests that it be expanded," the office said in a statement after Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius met the World Bank mission.
The Bank representatives were also satisfied with the progress in economic reforms, the office added.
It also said the Bank encouraged faster formation of private pension funds and urged reform in the troubled social insurance fund, which lacked adequate tax control.

The press office also said that the government reassured the Bank that it was determined to continue the privatisation of the two state-run banks to improve the health of the sector and to atract more capital.
